lines.en: : And so the ice cream man said to Ayane, “That’s no golden retriever! That’s my landlord!”
: What’s wrong? You normally love stories about the spontaneous yet lovable antics of Ayane Amamiya that always seem to have the beginnings cut out.
: Cut out of what, exactly?
: What?
: Nevermind.
I walk down the hall with Ami, preparing to leave[school] after a...day.
I don’t want to say it was a normal day, though...because it was really anything but.
Molly is still determined to try and clear things up with me after what happened on Halloween, and I’m running out of excuses when it comes to avoiding her.
Sooner or later, I’m going to have to look her in the eyes and admit to what happened...but that’s kind of impossible to do when I can’t even remember it.
The aftermath is still ingrained into my memory, though.
And each time I feel myself getting harder from thinking about it, I have to slow down and remind myself that none of it was real.
Or some of it was real.
Or none.
Or some.
Something did or didn’t happen.
I either liked or didn’t like it.

Part of me wishes that Tsuneyo would have just ended it right there, but I feel as if that part is not an actual desire of mine and just some selfish avoidance tactic buried underneath mountains of greed.
I’m tired of digging, though.
It’s impossible to know what lies beneath the surface without someone informing you, and I’ve always hated the feeling of dirt underneath my fingertips.
I don’t want to dig anymore.
I just want someone to unearth whatever’s down there and tell me what I’m supposed to do.
How do I turn things back to normal?
And what was normal in the first place?
Emotionless sex with a handful of girls who were already attached to me before I even had to do anything?
Is that what I want?
Or, scratch that-
Is that everything I want?
Yes.
That’s everything.
This is my life.
This is who I am.
Why would I ever want anything other than the easiest possible option?
Working for things is exhausting.
I can just not work.
I can have Ami do everything for me.
She’ll do it. She loves me.
I didn’t do anything to Molly. I wouldn’t have done anything.
Unless she wanted me to.
Did she want me to?
Is that why she wants to talk to me?
Does she want to do it again?
What-
: Sensei?
: What’s wrong?
: Nothing, Ami.
: It doesn’t look like nothing.
: It’s-
: Is it about Molly?
: What do you know about Molly?
: Uhh...nothing. I just noticed you were kinda avoiding her all day. And it seemed like it was a little more than just because she’s really annoying in...large doses.
: It’s not about her.
: I’m just tired.
: I see...
: Well, you can take a nap when we get home and I’ll make you dinner.
: It’s probably best to just stay home all day if you’re not feeling great. You can go be a weirdo dorm-invader some other time.
: ...Yeah.
: Actually, can I ask you something?
: Of course, Sensei. You can ask me anything you want.
: Is there anything I could do that would make you...feel differently for me than you do right now?
: Is there something specific you have in mind?
: No.
: Quick answer.
: Yes. But yours isn’t. Just tell me and-
: Of course not.
: I’ll love you forever and ever.
: The only question is whether or not that love will become too much for you one day.
: I don’t know what that’s supposed to mean.
: That’s just what you’re saying to yourself.
: You know, Sensei.
: I think you’ve always known.
: But that’s a story for another-
: There’s not a single thing you could do that would change that.
: Even if you became the most horrible person in the whole wide world, I’d still welcome you home with open arms and a warm bath.
: Then maybe even a little more if you know what I mean...
: You only have two modes. I definitely know what you mean.
: I’ve got a third one, too. It just hasn’t been turned on yet.
: That's...worrying?
: Sensei!
: Noriko? What are you-
: I’m sorry for my outburst during the Halloween party!
: It was impulsive and childish and I want to put it behind us!
: Please accept my apology!
: Outburst? Is this about the bathroom thing?
Why is she apologizing?
Because I fingered her sister?
She’s apologizing to me because I fingered her sister and she got upset about it?
I don’t understand.
Why do things keep happening that I don’t understand lately?
I should be saying sorry to her.
No. I didn’t do anything wrong.
All I did was slip my fingers inside of someone she’s related to.
Someone I’ve done that same thing to probably hundreds of times before.
If she gets upset about that, that’s on her.
I am not obligated to make her or anyone else happy. It would just make things better and easier if I did.
: I understand that this is probably not the best time to do this, but if I have to go one more night without telling you how I feel, I’m going to rip my hair out.
: It doesn’t matter to me what you do with anyone! Whether it be Niki or...Maya...or even Ami!
: It’s not even Ami when I am indisputably Sensei’s number one girl, thank you very much.
: The point is that I need to be stronger! And less sensitive!
: You don’t deserve to be burdened by the feelings of one more girl who doesn’t have her head on straight.
: So I want you to know that I, Noriko Nakayama, am not that!
: I am impulsive! And I am selfish! And I am far too sensitive at times!
: But I am strong! And independent! And so many more things that I want you to find out about!
: So please...accept my apology!
: Umm...
: I’m...going to go home now and start warming up the bath for you...
: I still don’t know what’s wrong, but...if it’s something involving Noriko and not Molly, maybe talking to her about it will make you feel better?...
: You’ve still gotta come home right away, though! Got it?
: Don’t go running off with other people from your past when you’ve got the perfect [niece] waiting at home for you!
: Really. Please don’t.
: I know I said there’s nothing you could ever do that would make me change how I feel, but that would still hurt a lot and I’d cry forever. Also, the house would flood because we are out of tissues.
: Why can’t you just use a sock or a t-shirt to do your business like a normal boy?
: Not that I know what a normal boy is when I’m just an innocent [niece] who-
: I’ll still come home, Ami. Just let me talk to Noriko first.
: Okay.
: I love you, Sensei.
: I love you too, Ami.
: Aww! I didn’t even have to tell you to say it that time!
: Bye-bye, Sensei! Bye, Noriko!
: Touch my [uncle] and I’ll cut your limbs off!
: Thank you very much, Ami! I am humbled by the privilege to spend time with your [uncle]!
: You know you don’t have to be that formal, right?
: You don’t even have to apologize for your outburst. Let’s just ignore it and move on with our lives.
: I can’t do that, Sensei.
: I’ve done something I promised not to do- and that’s getting in the way of you and someone else...Even if that someone else is my sister.
: But I made a new promise to myself that I would win your heart fair and square! And that means no telling you who to see or what to do!
: I want you to choose me for me! Not me as an alternative! And if your interest is going to wane, that just means I have to work harder!
: I realize that I am making a scene right now and that we have been likely receiving strange looks from some of the people in other classes...I can’t really tell because of the whole bowing thing-
: But I need you to know that I am serious! And that I will accept any punishment you deem necessary!
: Any punishment! No matter how sick or twisted it may be!
: And I know that now we’re probably getting even more stares, so it would be really nice if you would respond to me because I’m beginning to get embarrassed!
: He accepts!
: Such passion! Such determination!
: Of course he accepts your apology! He’d be foolish not to!
: I have to admit, when I heard you screaming from around the corner of the hall, I thought “Oh great. Teenage drama. Don’t wanna touch this with a ten foot pole.”
: But as my legs carried me closer and closer to the source of the noise, I was reminded that I live for this sort of thing! And now I wish nothing but the best for the two of you!
: I don’t even care that this guy’s probably twice your age! Give ‘em hell, girl!
: Just remember to invite me to the wedding since I’ve been there for you from the start!
: Who are you, exactly?
: Imani.
: Sorry, Imai. Keep forgetting we’re supposed to use last names first over here.
: But if you want to just call me Imani, that’s cool too. What’s your name? You look like a...
: Uhhhhhhhh...
: Jose.
: No.
: What are you even doing here? We’re kind of in the middle of something.
: Hey! Is that any way to treat the newest staff member at [kumon_mi_high]?!
: I’ve been nothing but accepting and supportive of you since the get-go and you’re already getting rid of me?! Where is my lawyer?!
: You work here?
: I’m filling in for uhh...Miss Watabe, I think? Whoever the one on medical leave is.
Oh...right.
Wakana not being around means that someone obviously has to look after her students.
So I guess this Imani girl is just going to be around until she comes back.
: Well...nice to meet you, I guess. But-
: Yeah, yeah. Hearts to break. Cradles to rock. I know how it is.
: Just take it easy on her, would ya? She seems really nice based on the five or six lines of dialogue I’ve heard from her.
: Anyway byeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee! See you around probably maybe unless I get fired! WE’LL SEE!
: Well, that was weird.
: Yes. But it did not prevent me from imagining her with her clothes off.
: I’m glad to see that she at least managed to lighten the mood a little. It’s weird seeing you get serious like that.
: I had to be.
: I hate coming off as weak or childish, and crying to you about a thing you did with my sister just made me look like some desperate loser who doesn’t want to actually fight for you.
: But I really do wanna fight, Sensei. I’m not a kid anymore.
: These feelings aren’t just...lingering traces of a first crush or...something I’ve become dependent on in order to get by. They’re real feelings. For you.
: So if bowing to you and asking for your forgiveness in the halls is the best way for me to get that across, I’ll be damned if I’m not gonna take the leap.
I sigh and attempt to force myself into the realization that I can’t control how Noriko or...how anyone else, for that matter, acts.
She’s still just a [teenage]girl at the end of the day, no matter how “adult” she tries to be.
The real adult thing to do in this scenario would just be bottling up those feelings and turning a simple misunderstanding into an event that would prevent us from ever seeing one another again.
It’s that immature striving for forgiveness...or the hope that things can eventually change that you only get to see from girls like her.
And, if even for only a moment, I’m reminded of why I’ve been having so much “fun” in Kumon-mi.
In moments like this, where my back isn’t against the wall.
Where I don’t have to take the passenger seat and let my disfigured sense of morals guide my actions.
Where I can live without the worry of how me living will impact others.
I wish it was possible to just ignore all of those more horrible parts of life.
But, then again, I’m sure that’s something everyone wishes.
: Okay. You’re forgiven.
: Really?!
: Is it that much of a surprise? This whole time, I’ve been saying you have nothing to apologize for.
: Yeah, I know. But you could have been lying. People lie about stuff like that all the time.
: I try to only lie when I have something to gain from it. This isn’t really one of those times.
: Besides, just crying and begging for me to not do something isn’t really childish in my book. You’re fine, Noriko.
: Then, umm...
: Can we maybe walk home together?
: I know that Ami asked you to come home right away, but...it’s not like the dorms are that big of a detour. And it would make me really happy if-
: Sure. I’m tired of just standing around here anyway.
: The sooner we get out of here, the better.
: Right!
: Just, uhh...
: I left my winter clothes in one of the gym lockers, so...I’m gonna run and grab them really quick.
Noriko sprints off in the direction of the gym and I don’t know what else to do but just...continue standing around.
I don’t like standing around.
I want to walk.
I need to walk.
I need to leave[school].
I need to-
: Okay! Ready to go.
: Already? It’s only been thirty seconds.
: What are you talking about?
: What’s only been thirty seconds?
: Weren’t we just in[school]?
: Define “just,” because we left like ten minutes ago.
: Also, are you sure it’s okay for me to be holding your arm like this? I was kinda joking when I suggested it, but I’m all for it if you’re actually enjoying it.
: Oh. Yeah, you’re fine. I don’t really care.
: Works for me! Your arms are a lot bigger now than when we were younger.
: That is how growing works, Noriko.
: I know, I know. Just...trying to make small talk since you seem a little out of it.
: I’m fine.
: I didn’t do anything.
I walk Noriko home and everything is good.
Noriko’s affection has increased to [noriko_love]!
I go home and fuck my [niece].
Noriko’s affection has increased to [noriko_love]!
Ami’s lust has increased to [ami_lust]!
Bed.
